name: PK modeling rules grounded in FDA, ICH and EMA guidance
principle: Guidance recommendations are nonbinding; numeric thresholds are project parameters, not regulatory certification.
activation_policy: Review each rule; route only the rules whose applies_to_stages match an agent. Do not append the whole pack to every agent.

status_legend.PARTIAL: present in part, or declared but not enforced

FDA_POPPK_2022.title: FDA Guidance for Industry: Population Pharmacokinetics

ICH_M15_2026.title: ICH M15 General Principles for Model-Informed Drug Development
ICH_M15_2026.version: ICH Step 4, 29 January 2026; FDA final guidance, June 2026

EMA_POPPK_REPORT_2007.title: EMA Guideline on reporting the results of population pharmacokinetic analyses

EMA_AM_PKPD_2016.title: EMA Guideline on the use of PK and PD in the development of antimicrobial medicinal products

ICH_M10_2022.title: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation and Study Sample Analysis

FDA_MRSD_2005.title: FDA Guidance: Estimating the Maximum Safe Starting Dose in Initial Clinical Trials for Therapeutics in Adult Healthy Volunteers

FDA_AI_2025.title: FDA Draft Guidance: Considerations for the Use of Artificial Intelligence to Support Regulatory Decision-Making for Drug and Biological Products

FDA_EMA_GAIP_2026.title: FDA-EMA Guiding Principles of Good AI Practice in Drug Development

rules.area: Question, context of use and plan
rules.title: Assessment table for every model use
rules.requirement: Record the question of interest, context of use, model influence, consequence of a wrong decision and model risk (low/medium/high, justified) for each model output.
rules.computable_check: Context JSON contains an assessment_table entry with all five fields for each requested model output; agents stop when it is absent.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Proposal v2.1 states the objective and prespecified criteria, but the context JSON has no assessment table or model-risk rating, so evaluation depth is not tied to risk.
rules.proposed_action: Add an assessment_table block to main.json at extraction; route the relevant row to each agent.
rules.title_zh: 每个模型用途的评估表（M15）

rules.area: Question, context of use and plan
rules.title: Model analysis plan before fitting
rules.requirement: Predefine data handling, model candidates, evaluation activities and technical criteria; document deviations in the report.
rules.computable_check: A versioned MAP object exists and is hash-bound to each fit request; the report lists deviations.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Pre-fit authorization and catalog criteria exist (e.g. structural correlation 0.95), but there is no MAP object and deviations are not tracked.
rules.proposed_action: Generate a MAP per analysis from the assessment table and catalog; require review of the MAP, not only of the run.
rules.title_zh: 拟合前的模型分析计划

rules.title: Censored data in the likelihood
rules.requirement: Handle BLQ data with an appropriate method (e.g. censored likelihood) and justify it with sensitivity analysis; never substitute zero or LLOQ/2.
rules.computable_check: Fit request declares censoring method; when BLQ exist, a censored fit and a quantified-only fit are both reported.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: BLQ records are preserved, not imputed, but the nlmixr2 adapter rejects censoring and the S21 LLOQ is unknown, so 2 BLQ values at 6 h sit outside the likelihood.
rules.proposed_action: Obtain the S21 LLOQ; pass CENS/LIMIT columns to nlmixr2 and report the sensitivity of CL and Vss.
rules.title_zh: 删失数据进入似然

rules.title: Exclusions and outliers prespecified
rules.requirement: Prespecify how outliers are identified; keep exclusions minimal and documented; refit the final model on the complete data to show their influence.
rules.computable_check: Exclusion ledger attached to every fit; influence refit present when any record is excluded.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: The 8 non-quantified rat records are quarantined with reasons. No outlier rule or influence analysis exists; rat 2 was the failed leave-one-out fold and has the longest half-life (2.5 h).
rules.proposed_action: Add an influence check (leave-one-animal-out parameter change) to the evaluation step.
rules.title_zh: 预先规定排除与离群值

rules.title: Assay qualification evidence
rules.requirement: Carry analyte, matrix, LLOQ and validation status into model qualification; unknown is not failed.
rules.computable_check: Each dataset has an assay card with LLOQ, analyte definition and validation status (VALIDATED/UNKNOWN).
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: EDA rules cover assay limits, but fit requests carry no structured assay card.
rules.proposed_action: Adopt the assay card proposed in PK-AUDIT-002.
rules.title_zh: 检测方法资质证据

rules.title: Converged minimum and covariance step
rules.requirement: A model used for inference must reach a converged minimum with a successful covariance step and identifiable parameters.
rules.computable_check: Screen fails when the engine reports gradient/covariance problems or a non-minimum objective.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: The screen correctly flags all 6 rat candidates (engine messages: gradient problems with covariance; objective not at minimum). Numerical eligibility is kept separate from scientific acceptance.
rules.proposed_action: Keep. Add the checks in PKMR-07 and PKMR-08 to the same screen.
rules.title_zh: 收敛到最小值且协方差步骤成功

rules.title: Condition number on a declared matrix
rules.requirement: Report the condition number (largest/smallest eigenvalue); values above about 1000 indicate the data cannot support one or more parameters.
rules.computable_check: Screen records the condition number of the correlation matrix of estimates and states which matrix was used.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Not computed by the screen. For the rat 2C combined fit: 3,555 on the covariance matrix, 308 on the correlation matrix, 30 on the structural block.
rules.proposed_action: Record the correlation-matrix condition number in candidate_result.json; treat the threshold as a project parameter.
rules.title_zh: 在明确矩阵上计算条件数

rules.title: Correlations across all estimated parameters
rules.requirement: Assess identifiability from correlations among all estimates, including variance components, not only structural parameters.
rules.computable_check: Maximum absolute correlation over the full estimate vector is reported with the parameter pair.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Only structural pairs are checked (max 0.86). The full matrix has Q vs omega^2(VC) = -0.93 and VP vs omega^2(VC) = -0.86, so the VC variability trades off against the distribution phase.
rules.proposed_action: Compute correlations on the full covariance matrix; report the top pairs.
rules.title_zh: 所有估计参数间的相关性

rules.title: Random-effect correlation
rules.requirement: Inspect correlations between random effects; simulations must account for them to avoid unrealistic parameter combinations.
rules.computable_check: Report the EBE correlation matrix; when |r| is material and shrinkage is low, fit a block omega as a candidate.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: The rat plan fixes a diagonal omega. EBE correlation eta_CL vs eta_VC = 0.71 (p = 0.014) with near-zero shrinkage. Simulating with that correlation moves the NPC from 0% to 2.9% of observations below the 5th percentile.
rules.proposed_action: Add a block-omega candidate (CL-VC) to the rat model plan and compare on the same data.
rules.title_zh: 随机效应之间的相关性

rules.title: Shrinkage reported with its consequence
rules.requirement: Report ETA and EPS shrinkage; above roughly 20-30% (SD-based), EBE-based diagnostics and exposures become unreliable. Shrinkage alone is not a model-selection criterion.
rules.computable_check: candidate_result.json carries shrinkage values; EBE-based downstream use is blocked above the project threshold.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: R writes shrinkage.csv but the value is not passed downstream. Rat 2C combined: eta SD shrinkage -3.6% (CL), -1.9% (VC); IWRES 10%.
rules.proposed_action: Pass shrinkage into the candidate row and the reviewer payload.
rules.title_zh: 报告收缩率及其后果

rules.title: Standard goodness-of-fit set, stratified
rules.requirement: Provide DV vs PRED and IPRED, CWRES vs time and PRED, |IWRES| vs IPRED, QQ of random effects and individual plots, stratified by design factors.
rules.computable_check: All listed plots exist for the candidate and are referenced in the review payload.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Individual and residual plots are produced in R, but reviewers receive only numeric summaries and plots are not stratified by dose or study.
rules.proposed_action: Include compact residual summaries by time bin in the reviewer payload (PK-AUDIT-004).
rules.title_zh: 标准拟合优度图，按设计分层

rules.title: Physiological plausibility
rules.requirement: Check point estimates for physiological plausibility and, after the freeze, against previous analyses.
rules.computable_check: A plausibility record compares CL and Vss with species physiology and a model-independent NCA.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Not a computed check. Independent NCA agrees: geometric-mean CL 0.211 (NCA) vs 0.195 L/h/kg (NLME); Vss 0.43 vs 0.36 L/kg. Published-value comparison is correctly deferred to after the freeze.
rules.proposed_action: Add an NCA cross-check step before comparison; keep literature values blinded until the freeze.
rules.title_zh: 生理合理性

rules.title: Simulation-based predictive check
rules.requirement: Evaluate the model with VPC, pcVPC, NPC or NPDE; several methods together, chosen for the purpose.
rules.computable_check: A predictive-check receipt exists with the percentage of observations outside the 90% PI and the binomial range expected.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Not implemented in any adapter. An independent NPC of the rat 2C combined fit: 97.1% within the 90% PI and 0 of 102 below the 5th percentile (about 5 expected; P = 0.005 if calibrated).
rules.proposed_action: Add an evaluation node that runs VPC/NPC with a fixed seed; the attached rat_model_checks.py is a reference implementation.
rules.title_zh: 基于模拟的预测检查（VPC/NPC/NPDE）

rules.title: Uncertainty beyond asymptotic standard errors
rules.requirement: Estimate parameter uncertainty with bootstrap, SIR or likelihood profiling where asymptotic SEs are unreliable; account for failed replicates.
rules.computable_check: A resampling or profile result exists for each structural parameter used downstream.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Only sandwich (r,s) standard errors, which are conditional on the unresolved numerical warnings.
rules.proposed_action: Add an animal-level bootstrap (11 rats) or profile likelihood for CL and Vss; report failed replicates.
rules.title_zh: 超越渐近标准误的不确定性

rules.title: Internal and external validation kept distinct
rules.requirement: Label validation on model-building data as internal; use independent data for external validation; keep every failed fold.
rules.computable_check: Evaluation record lists data lineage and overlap with development data.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: The 19 Sep leave-one-rat-out run passed 10 of 11 folds (rat 2 failed to converge); the current run records CV_status NOT_PERFORMED.
rules.proposed_action: Re-run leave-one-rat-out on the revised model with identical settings per fold.
rules.title_zh: 内部验证与外部验证分开

rules.title: Sensitivity analysis for extrapolation
rules.requirement: When simulating beyond studied conditions, run sensitivity analysis of the parameters on the decision metric.
rules.computable_check: Each human prediction carries a tornado or scenario table for CL, Vss, fu and the allometric exponent.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: No sensitivity step exists; the human branch is not built.
rules.proposed_action: Specify sensitivity outputs in the human_pk contract.
rules.title_zh: 外推时的敏感性分析

rules.title: Human prediction with a complete, justified parameter set
rules.requirement: Record every scaled or assumed parameter, the scaling method and its uncertainty; revalidate a model when its purpose changes.

sources.section: dose conversion uses BSA (W^0.67); PK scaling is not prescribed

rules.computable_check: human_pk output lists CL, Vc, Q, Vp, fu and exponents with source and uncertainty.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: The translation module is not implemented. No FDA guidance prescribes an exponent for scaling clearance; the 0.75/1.0 catalog choice is a project choice and must be labelled as one.
rules.proposed_action: Build the human_pk module against PK-AUDIT-009.
rules.title_zh: 人体预测使用完整且有依据的参数集

rules.title: Frozen prediction and prespecified acceptance
rules.requirement: Freeze predictions before opening human data; apply prespecified acceptance criteria; keep failures visible.
rules.computable_check: Prediction files are hash-frozen before the holdout is opened; criteria come from the MAP.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Proposal v2.1 fixes the Hanafin 2021 criteria and the holdout is enforced by routing, but no freeze-then-validate step exists yet.
rules.proposed_action: Implement the freeze receipt and the validation step.
rules.title_zh: 冻结预测与预设接受标准

rules.title: Hold-out integrity and leakage control
rules.requirement: Keep test data independent of development; published fitted results cannot drive primary modeling.
rules.computable_check: Routing rejects human and benchmark files from animal development; initial estimates come from the data.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Human data are routed out of animal development; rat initial estimates are data-derived (published_fitted_parameters_used = false).
rules.proposed_action: Keep.
rules.title_zh: 保留集独立与防泄漏

rules.title: PK/PD target definition
rules.requirement: Express indices on free drug; report stasis, 1-log and 2-log targets; use dose fractionation to separate indices.
rules.computable_check: Index comparison requires matched regimen-response records and returns INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: EDA rules PKPD15-PKPD20 encode this, and the pipeline correctly reports the index as not estimable (0 matched regimen-response rows).
rules.proposed_action: Keep.
rules.title_zh: PK/PD 靶值定义

rules.title: Probability of target attainment
rules.requirement: Use Monte Carlo simulation with justified n and distributions; report PTA per MIC in tables and graphs with 95% CIs; include MICs at the upper end of the distribution; the expected PTA is above 90%.
rules.computable_check: PTA output has per-MIC PTA, 95% CI, MIC range and the simulated-n justification.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: No PTA module. Proposal v2.1 already specifies 10,000 subjects, seed 20260922 and a 90% cutoff. EMA expects PTA inputs from a patient popPK model where possible.
rules.proposed_action: Build the PTA module against these outputs.
rules.title_zh: 达标概率（PTA）

rules.title: Verification of code and equations
rules.requirement: Verify user-written code, equations and calculations; keep the evidence reviewable.
rules.computable_check: Independent re-derivation of predictions matches the engine within tolerance.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: An independent matrix-exponential solution reproduced all 102 IPRED values of the rat 2C fit (max relative difference 2.2e-14). 288 Python and 37 R tests exist.
rules.proposed_action: Add the re-derivation to the automated evaluation step.
rules.title_zh: 代码与方程验证

rules.title: Reliable, reproducible computerized system
rules.requirement: Modeling uses a validated computerized system that is reliable, reproducible and traceable, with documented software testing.
rules.computable_check: CI runs the test suites on each commit; R and Python environments are pinned in the repository.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: SHA-256 receipts and audit trails are strong. There is no CI, R packages are not pinned (no renv lock), and many paths are absolute Windows paths.
rules.proposed_action: Add CI, an renv.lock and path configuration.
rules.title_zh: 可靠、可复现的计算机化系统

rules.title: Context of use and risk for each LLM role
rules.requirement: For each AI component, define the question, context of use and model risk (influence x consequence).
rules.computable_check: Each agent contract names its COU and risk rating.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: The design keeps LLMs out of numerical estimation and acceptance, which keeps influence low, but no contract records a COU or risk rating.
rules.proposed_action: Add cou and model_risk fields to every agent contract (extraction, review, planning).
rules.title_zh: 每个 LLM 角色的使用情境与风险
rules.area_zh: AI 与 LLM 可信度

rules.title: Evidence that the LLM steps perform
rules.requirement: Evaluate AI outputs on representative, independent test data with predefined metrics and repeated runs; document deviations.
rules.computable_check: A benchmark report with per-case results across repeats and at least one non-PMB proposal.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Only 3 of 7 synthetic cases were run live, once each; 4 were never run; one parallel review failed on an engineering error. No accuracy is measured on real proposals.
rules.proposed_action: Run all 7 cases 3 times each, add two non-PMB proposals, and record miss and false-alarm counts.
rules.title_zh: LLM 步骤的性能证据
rules.area_zh: AI 与 LLM 可信度

rules.title: Pinned and recorded model identity
rules.requirement: Record the AI model version used for every output; model changes trigger re-evaluation.
rules.computable_check: Every call record contains the resolved model ID; a change invalidates dependent approvals.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Calls record requested_model = CLI_DEFAULT and no resolved model ID, so results cannot be tied to a model version.
rules.proposed_action: Pass an explicit model to codex exec and store the resolved ID in call.json and the review receipt.
rules.title_zh: 固定并记录模型版本
rules.area_zh: AI 与 LLM 可信度

rules.title: Reviewers see the evidence they judge
rules.requirement: Assess the full human-AI system; a reviewer can only judge evidence it received.
rules.computable_check: Reviewer payload lists the evidence supplied; unsupplied checks return NOT_ASSESSED.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: Rat reviewers receive numeric summaries only; the reviewer itself noted that no residual plots were supplied.
rules.proposed_action: Adopt PK-AUDIT-004.
rules.title_zh: 审阅者看到其所判断的证据
rules.area_zh: AI 与 LLM 可信度

rules.title: Rule routing that generalizes to a new drug
rules.requirement: Rules reach agents through structured tags assigned and reviewed at extraction, not through drug-specific text matching.
rules.computable_check: task_rules.py contains no proposal-specific sentences; a non-PMB proposal routes without code changes.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: task_rules.py matches and rewrites exact PMB proposal sentences. Unknown clauses stop the agent (safe), but a new drug will stall until code is edited.
rules.proposed_action: Have the extraction step emit stage tags per rule clause, reviewed once by a person; keep regex routing only as a fallback suggestion.
rules.title_zh: 可推广到新药的规则路由

rules.title: Unambiguous status labels in agent context
rules.requirement: Status and reason fields must read the same way to people and to LLM reviewers.
rules.computable_check: Failed checks are reported as failure statements.
rules.finding_24_sep_2026: candidate_result.json lists a failed check as reasons: ["no_critical_engine_messages"], which reads as a pass.
rules.proposed_action: Emit failed checks as e.g. "critical_engine_messages_present".
rules.title_zh: 代理上下文中无歧义的状态标签
